newsitem.title: USA: Submicron sees Q3, Q4 charges.
newsitem.headline: Submicron sees Q3, Q4 charges.

text.p: SubMicron Systems Corp said on Wednesday it will post third and fourth quarter charges of $1.5 million and $1.0 million, respectively.
The charges stem from a restructuring plan as it focuses on its core wet-wafer cleaning competencies, SubMicron said in a statement.
As previously announced, the sale of principally all the net assets of the company's Systems Chemistry subsidiary is proceeding as planned and is expected to close in July 1997.

"Due to softening market conditions, we are still concerned with the backlog levels for the third and fourth quarter of 1997," David Ferran, the company's president and chief executive, said in a statement.
